about: Lane D1's own fixtures of the task-queue read of spec 4.4.6 (GET /command/queue), which lane L's route does not serve yet. Each case is one body the server may answer; `keeps` says the desk may draw it, and `slot`, `rows` and `text` say what a desk drawing it must show in English and in Russian (the times are Moscow, UTC+3).

en: Project queue
